label: Programmatic alignment
description: Align the proposed Behavioral Health Aide program with the IHS BHA model, tribal health priorities, and local community needs.

scoring.desc: Program design does not follow the BHA model or skips certification pathways.
Program follows the BHA model but community alignment is thin.
Program follows the BHA model, maps to tribal health plan priorities, and has community endorsement.

label: Workforce pipeline
description: Describe a recruitment, training, supervision, and retention plan that builds a sustainable BHA workforce.

scoring.desc: Recruitment plan exists but supervision or retention is not addressed.
Plan covers recruitment, training, clinical supervision, retention, and advancement from BHA I to BHA III.

common_failures: Training costs omitted from the budget

label: Outcomes measurement
description: Define behavioral health outcomes, indicators, data sources, and a reporting cadence that matches IHS expectations.

scoring.desc: Outcomes are not defined or data sources are absent.
Outcomes are defined but measurement is output-level only.
Outcomes are specific, indicator-mapped, and measurable with named data sources and cadence.

common_failures: No EHR or data system identified

label: Organizational capacity
description: Show the tribal health organization has clinical infrastructure, compliance systems, and prior IHS or federal experience.

scoring.desc: Applicant lacks clinical infrastructure or has unresolved compliance issues.
Applicant has infrastructure but limited IHS program history.
Applicant has existing clinical infrastructure, prior IHS awards, and clean compliance history.
